Tickets.Subject: There’s more to explore in Microsoft 365

Entries.Message: Du får ikke ofte mails fra microsoft365@communication.microsoft.com. Få mere at vide om, hvorfor dette er vigtigt Here’s how to get started quickly with the tools included in your subscription. Make the most of your Microsoft 365 subscriptionIt looks like your team hasn’t used some of the top features of your Microsoft 365 subscription. Transform the way you work with powerful tools like SharePoint, OneNote, PowerPoint, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. Not sure where to start? Get up to speed fast with these tips, hints, and resources.  Explore the guide  ‌See what you can do with Microsoft 365Discover how these popular Microsoft 365 apps can help you spark creativity, stay organized, and do your best work.  Collaborate securely with SharePointShare content, store files, and manage documents in connected team spaces. Learn more. Stay on task with OneNoteCapture ideas, meeting notes, and action items all in one place, accessible across all your devices. Learn more. Build your brand with PowerPointCreate polished, professional presentations using built-in templates and smart design suggestions. Learn more. Get work done faster with Copilot ChatBrainstorm, check things off your to-do list, and:   Turn your ideas into first drafts fast.   Quickly rewrite text to help improve clarity and tone.   Get answers to your questions in the flow of work.   Copilot Chat works across all Microsoft 365 apps and supports everyday work so you can save time and focus on what matters most. Try it now.This email was sent from an unmonitored mailbox. Privacy Statement | Unsubscribe Microsoft Corporation, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, WA 98052 USA
